On National Agriculture Day, I’m proud to celebrate the hardworking farmers, cattlemen, and families who keep Alabama and America running.

The Working Families Tax Cuts Act delivered real results for Alabama agriculture—strengthening our farm safety net, investing in research, expanding market access, and protecting family farms for generations to come.

Our nation will be forever grateful to these six American heroes who paid the ultimate sacrifice. I led a resolution in their honor, which passed the Senate unanimously this week.

While their lives were tragically cut short, we will never forget their valor as they selflessly served and defended our country. Please join me in continuing to pray for their loved ones. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

Congratulations to my dear friend @SenMullin on his confirmation as our next Secretary of Homeland Security.

We’re sad to lose him in the Senate, but I’m thrilled that he is taking up the mantle at DHS. There is no one better equipped to meet this moment than Markwayne.

He is committed to securing our interior, standing by our law enforcement, and executing President Trump’s agenda. 

I can’t wait to see everything he’s going to accomplish.

Why should members of Congress get paid after failing to do our most basic job and ensure hardworking Americans receive their paychecks?

We shouldn’t. It’s time to pass @SenRickScott’s No Budget, No Pay Act.


Rick Scott (@SenRickScott)

Did you know politicians in Congress are getting paid during the DHS shutdown while TSA agents don’t get paid? It’s ridiculous that Congress can fail but have no accountability. I have a way to fix it: the No Budget, No Pay Act.

I want to fund ALL of DHS, but

Absolutely, @SenRickScott. The American people expect us to do our job, and we should be held accountable when we don’t.

That’s why I am a proud co-sponsor of the No Budget, No Pay Act. No more excuses. The Senate must pass this legislation.


Rick Scott (@SenRickScott)

Thanks to Democrats’ shutdown, TSA agents haven’t been paid for over a MONTH. It’s wrong! 

We need to pass my No Budget, No Pay Act, so that next time Dems hold people’s paychecks hostage, they feel the squeeze too.

Hadrian’s new shipbuilding facility will help unleash a Maritime Golden Age and ensure Alabamians are at the forefront of a peace through strength agenda across the globe.

American manufacturing is back.

U.S. Senator John Fetterman (@SenFettermanPA)

As a father, I grieve for Sheridan’s parents for this unspeakable tragedy.

This was a failure of not holding criminal migrants accountable and not protecting the public—and another tragic reason why I was the Dem lead on the Laken Riley law.

Sheridan Gorman was a college student in Chicago with her whole life ahead of her, which was tragically cut short because of the Biden Administration’s open border policies.

Make sure everyone in America knows Sheridan’s name and her story. We must stand with our law enforcement officers and END sanctuary cities.


Bill Melugin (@BillMelugin_)

It’s critical that they are fully funded. We cannot walk away from our law enforcement officers.

Yet another Venezuelan illegal alien allowed into the country by the Biden administration, then released again by a sanctuary jurisdiction on a shoplifting arrest, now

Proud to support @SenJohnKennedy’s No Shutdown Paychecks to Politicians Act. We must have a vote on this.
